# User Journeys and Core Functionality

This document outlines the main user journeys and functionality within the Chess
Opening Explorer. Use this as a reference for feature completeness, E2E test
planning, and product roadmap.

## 1. Discover Openings (Landing Page)

The entry point for finding new openings and managing personal repertoire.

### Search & Discovery

- **Natural Language & Semantic Search**: Find openings by descriptive themes
  (e.g., "aggressive gambit for white") via server-side
  `/api/openings/semantic-search`.
- **Global Header Search**: Instant, debounced fuzzy search for specific opening
  names using a lightweight search index.
- **PGN Identification**: Paste complete PGN move sequences to identify the
  deepest matching opening in the database.
- **"Surprise Me"**: Navigate to a random, high-quality opening from the
  database.
- **Popularity Showcase**: View the "Most Popular" openings based on real-time
  Lichess master game statistics.
- **Site Statistics**: Visibility into database coverage and total analyzed
  positions.

### Repertoire Management

- **Personal Repertoire**: Star openings to save them to a local "Starred" list
  (stored in LocalStorage).
- **Manage Saved Openings**: View, navigate to, or remove openings from your
  repertoire directly from the landing page.

---

## 2. Opening Detail Page

The dedicated learning environment for mastering a specific position.

### Move Mastery

- **Mainline Move Navigation**: Interactive chessboard with a list of historical
  moves for quick navigation.
- **Practice Mode (Move Trainer)**:
  - **Interactive Play**: Play through the opening sequence with real-time
    feedback (accepts correct moves, rejects others).
  - **Perspective Flip**: Practice as either White or Black with board flip
    support.
  - **Dynamic Hint System**: Receive visual "amber" hints if stuck
    (automatically triggers after 2 incorrect attempts).
  - **Sensory Feedback**: Audio feedback for moves and completions, plus
    Lichess-style visual move indicators.
  - **Mobile-First UX**: Full "Tap-to-Move" support for mobile devices.

### Strategic Content

- **AI-Enriched Insights**: Detailed descriptions, strategic themes, and common
  plans generated by LLMs.
- **Classification Metadata**: Instant identification of position type
  (Mainline, Variation, Sideline) and ECO/SCID codes.
- **Tags & Attributes**: Visualization of complexity, tactical nature, and
  typical player style suited for the opening.

### Tabbed Resource Learning

- **Overview**: High-level win rate statistics and move progression.
- **Plans**: Deep dive into strategic themes and common goals for both sides.
- **Studies Gallery**: Curated Lichess study chapters matched by FEN position
  (6,100+ chapters).
- **Video Gallery**: Hand-picked YouTube videos from top educators matched to
  the exact position.

### Navigation & Feedback

- **Hierarchical "Teasers"**: Inline expandable explorer to see sub-variations
  or navigate back to the Mainline.
- **External Deep Links**: Quick navigation to Lichess (Play/Analysis) or
  Chessable.
- **Community Feedback**: Report errors in moves or AI content via the "Help
  make Opening Book better" link in the global footer (Google Form).

---

## 3. Analyse Games Page (Personal Explorer)

Connect your real-game performance with the opening database.

### Data Integration

- **Personal History Import**: One-click import from Chess.com or Lichess by
  username.
- **Smart Filtering**: Automatically identifies Rated Rapid, Blitz, and
  Classical games (excluding Bullet and variants).

### Performance Insights

- **Color-Based Performance**: Compare your winning percentages as White vs.
  Black (side-by-side columns on desktop, an As White / As Black switch on
  mobile).
- **Family Rollups**: Group openings by family (e.g. Sicilian, Vienna, French)
  to see an aggregate W/D/L distribution per family, then expand a family to its
  per-variation breakdown. Each side has its own `Group by family` toggle
  (default on) and `Sort` control (most played / highest / lowest win rate);
  uncategorised openings collapse into a single footnote line.
- **Strengths & Weaknesses**: Identification of "Top-performing" openings vs.
  those "Needing Work" (based on personal history).
- **Distribution Bars**: Every row shows a win/draw/loss distribution bar with
  counts and percentages — the same graph in both the family and all-openings
  views.

### Improvement Loop

- **Contextual Study**: Click any opening in your personal stats to go straight
  to the **Opening Detail Page** to practice the correct mainline.
- **Deep Historical Search**: Direct links back to the original platform to see
  all your games in a specific line.
